environment.description: AWS Lambda (Node.js 18.x) deployed in isolated VPC subnet with no internet gateway. Function invoked exclusively through API Gateway REST API with request validator 'body-only' enabled referencing a JSON schema model that enforces string-type constraints with maxLength:128 and pattern '^[\\w\\s@.\\-]+$' on all fields (name, email, subject, message limited to '^[\\w\\s.,!?\\-]+$' with maxLength:2000). The API Gateway resource policy restricts invoke to CloudFront distribution origin only. Lambda execution role scoped to ses:SendEmail (NOT ses:SendRawEmail) with condition key ses:FromAddress equals 'noreply@example.com'. Container runtime has CAP_NET_RAW and CAP_SYS_ADMIN dropped via Lambda SnapStart security profile. SES sending authorization policy on the verified identity restricts ses:SendRawEmail to a different principal (the CI/CD pipeline role only).

config.api_gateway_request_validator: body-only with JSON schema: name/email/subject pattern '^[\\w\\s@.\\-]+$' maxLength:128
config.ses_sending_authorization: ses:SendRawEmail restricted to CI/CD pipeline role ARN only
config.vpc_config: isolated subnet, no NAT/IGW, VPC endpoint for SES only
config.api_gateway_resource_policy: allow invoke from CloudFront distribution only
